The approach is deliberately simple: durable umbrellas, weatherproof stands, and a
phone-free borrow-and-return flow that anyone can use without an account. Stands
are stocked from a small central depot and rebalanced on a weekly cycle informed
by which stops run dry. The concept's novelty is social rather than technical — it
treats umbrellas as shared civic infrastructure, and its success is judged purely
by coverage and return rate, not by any proprietary hardware.
